input.injected_failure: zip process exits non-zero (disk full mid-archive)

notes: createSlot creates the empty slot directory first (line 425), then runs /usr/bin/zip into it. On a non-zero exit status (line 447), it removes the just-created slot directory (line 449) before returning nil -- no half-written slot.json or partial zip is left behind, and the live world folders it was archiving from were never modified in the first place (createSlot only ever reads them).
